# `company.payment_bounces`

Bounced customer checks: the receipt, the refund that took the cash back out of the bank, and the fee documents.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this bounced-check record. |
| `payment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_payment_bounces_payment | transactions.id | Customer receipt whose check the bank returned. |
| `operation_key` | VARCHAR(128) | no | — | unique | — | — | Caller-chosen key of the bounce; asking again with it returns this record instead of bouncing twice. |
| `refund_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | transactions.id | Customer refund that took the returned amount back out of the bank; the receipt is bounced while it is posted. |

| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that recorded the bounce. |
